typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		rackNumber as string,
		temperature as string,
		rackName as string,
		humidity as string,
		Timestamp as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SourceDatabankSensorsCSV
SourceDatabankSensorsCSV sink(input(
		RackNumber as string,
		Temperature as string,
		RackName as string,
		Humidity as string,
		SensorTimestamp as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,errorHandlingOption: 'allErrors',reportSuccessOnError: true,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		RackNumber = rackNumber,
		Temperature = temperature,
		RackName = rackName,
		Humidity = humidity,
		SensorTimestamp = Timestamp),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
